name: Daily Standup
description: Per-person progress, plans and blockers, kept short.

sections.heading: Progress
sections.instruction: What each person reported completing. Group by person where the transcript identifies them; otherwise list the work.

sections.heading: Planned
sections.instruction: What each person said they are working on next.

sections.heading: Blockers
sections.instruction: Anything reported as blocked or at risk, and who is blocked on whom. Omit this section if nothing was raised.

sections.heading: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: Commitments made during the standup that need to happen outside it.
